design_notes: Extends beyond the brief's original 0-300 umol/kg range to 500 umol/kg so that precipitation-risk thresholds, if real, appear inside the modeled range rather than at its edge (cold, low-saturation-state waters may not cross risk thresholds below 300 umol/kg).
Rows with stress_test = true can be excluded to report headline statistics under a more conservative, field-realistic dose range.
Every environment draw (env_id) is paired with the full 12-level ladder, enabling within-environment marginal-efficiency calculations without confounding by environment.
verification_needed: Exact mesocosm/experimental ΔTA ranges used to justify the 150-500 umol/kg stress-test doses are marked SOURCE VERIFICATION REQUIRED until located.
